text:
camille: Quick pre-cutoff sweep — who is owning GH draft assets for v1.8.0? Need: annotated tag, upload of build artifacts, checksums, and final draft publish. If you can own a step, reply with which one.

jordan_k: I can take the changelog bump & verify the changelog entry. Will push the changelog commit now.

camille: thanks jordan_k. tag + publish need a single owner so we don't step on each other. ideally someone uploads S3 artifacts and then the tag author creates the draft release and attaches.

maria-ops: I can upload artifacts (linux wheel + mac wheel + container tar). Where should I put the s3 path?

camille: use s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0/staging/ and follow the naming convention: redwood-core-1.8.0-{linux,mac}.tar.gz. Also create SHA256 checksums next to each file.

release-bot: Checklist: [ ] changelog commit present, [ ] artifacts uploaded, [ ] checksums present, [ ] annotated tag created, [ ] GH draft release created, [ ] assets attached, [ ] publish.

sam: quick q — who has the signing key for annotated tags? We need to GPG sign the tag (or opt for unsigned and note the reason).

camille: sam — I have the signing key but prefer not to GPG sign from my laptop for this release. Two options: 1) I sign via CI using the release signing service (preferred) or 2) we create an unsigned annotated tag and note that signing will be done post-publish. Which do you prefer?

sam: let's do CI signing. Maria, can you coordinate upload to S3 so CI can pick up artifacts and produce signed tag?

maria-ops: yep, uploading now. Will push to s3 path and DM the CI job id.

jordan_k: changelog commit pushed: refs/heads/release/1.8.0-changelog -> please review quickly.

camille: Lucid checklist for whoever executes tag/publish (copy/paste):

```bash
# create annotated tag locally (if needed)
git tag -a v1.8.0 -m "v1.8.0: release notes summary"
# sign via CI: trigger job 'release/sign-and-publish' with S3 path
# checksum example
sha256sum redwood-core-1.8.0-linux.tar.gz > redwood-core-1.8.0-linux.tar.gz.sha256
```

camille: If CI signing fails, fallback: create unsigned annotated tag and mark release notes with "unsigned - signing pending". Please add a reaction when you own a step.

maria-ops: I own artifacts upload — :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll wire up CI signing job id when artifacts are in — :thumbsup:

jordan_k: changelog reviewed and approved — :white_check_mark:

camille: OK looks good. I'll take final GH draft publish once assets are attached and CI confirms signed tag. Targeting publish within the cutoff window. Thanks everyone.
